name: WorthyDeath
description:
🎮 WORTHY: Bedrock Edition is welcome!

Play on phone, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch or Windows together with Java players on the same server.

How to join on Bedrock:

Server Address: domination-brooks.tun.ply.gg

Port: 19132

(Java players use play.worthydeath.com)

What’s waiting for you:

⚔️ 12 epic bosses with unique abilities: fight them alone or with your team

🏰 Raids in Normal, Heroic and Mythic difficulty

🛡️ 9 armour sets and legendary gear you earn, never buy

🗡️ KitPvP arenas and open-world PvP

🌕 Blood Moon nights with stronger mobs and better loot

🎁 Crates, events, parkour and a custom-built world

📱 Bedrock-friendly menus: shops and GUIs open as native forms, easy to use on touch screens

💯 0% pay2win: real money only buys cosmetics

🔓 No Xbox purchase checks: free accounts welcome

Join now and prove you’re WORTHY.
